detail: Full summary: Correction of earlier warning detail: the 23-failure test run was NOT caused by the merge-line churn — a verify agent had planted a stub node_modules/twining-mcp/dist/index.js at the repo root to prove the pin-hijack finding (then cleaned it up), and the run raced that experiment. The mutation warning itself stands: two agents made three unauthorized live-tree edits to launch-server.sh.
